scope: Skill provenance research: Kai Kai through Light Grenade

records.name: Kai Kai
records.repository_evidence: Canonical PQ63 relationship is exact; current record already identifies PQ63 Basic Reward and Whis association.
records.research_result: Independent technique documentation confirms Kai Kai as a Xenoverse 2 Super Skill and a cost-free teleportation technique; repository's PQ63 acquisition remains the canonical acquisition endpoint.
records.limits: No new reward probability or Ultimate Finish gate inferred.

records.name: Kaioken
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies PQ8 Ultimate Finish and 100/300/500 Ki stages.
records.research_result: Current skill documentation confirms PQ8 Ultimate Finish acquisition and the three Ki thresholds; independent GameFAQs discussion corroborates the PQ8/x3-Goku route while not establishing a guaranteed drop.
records.limits: No exact drop percentage inferred from community reports.

records.name: Kaioken Kamehameha
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies PQ14 and 200 Ki.
records.research_result: Current skill documentation confirms the Xenoverse 2 Super classification, PQ14 unlock, and 200 Ki cost; broader technique documentation confirms the skill's Xenoverse 2 identity and distinction from the x4/x20 Ultimate variants.

records.name: Kairos Cannon
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies Conton City Tournament Match 2 / Thinning the Herd provenance.
records.research_result: Current documentation confirms Kairos Cannon as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super associated with Supreme Kai of Time; it is obtained from the Conton City Tournament's Thinning the Herd route and uses Holy Inscription hits to increase the stored projectile count.
records.limits: Different secondary descriptions disagree on maximum projectile count; repository retains its existing bounded mechanics rather than promoting the discrepancy.

records.name: Kamehameha
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record is the base Kamehameha Super record; exact existing acquisition fields remain authoritative unless separately contradicted.
records.research_result: Current skill documentation confirms Kamehameha as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super available to CaCs, with charge levels producing different hit counts; full damage varies with distance.
records.limits: This audit does not replace the repository's existing acquisition endpoint without an exact source-to-field comparison.

records.name: Ki Blast Thrust
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies Yamcha training provenance.
records.research_result: Independent documentation confirms Xenoverse 2 acquisition through Yamcha Training School Quest Lesson 2 and describes the ki-enhanced charging punch that can cancel weak Ki Blasts.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.repository_evidence: Canonical relationship data associates the skill with PQ77.
records.research_result: Current skill documentation confirms Ki Explosion as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ77; it can prolong the area explosion by holding the input and consumes additional Ki while extended.

records.name: Kill Driver
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies Turles training provenance.
records.research_result: Current skill documentation confirms Kill Driver as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super obtained from Turles training; the projectile can be charged and detonated with additional input.
records.limits: No new numerical damage values promoted beyond the directly documented current reference.

records.name: Last Emperor
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies PQ71 provenance and Ki Blast Ultimate classification.
records.research_result: Current documentation confirms Last Emperor as a 0-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ71; it can be used only once at low health, matching its documented health-based restriction.

records.name: Light Grenade
records.repository_evidence: Canonical record identifies Piccolo mentor-training provenance.
records.research_result: Independent documentation confirms Xenoverse 2 acquisition through Piccolo Training School Quest Lesson 2 and describes its chargeable multi-stage Super Skill behavior; the Hero of Justice Pack 2 Ultimate variant is distinct from the base Super Skill.
records.limits: No conflation of the base Super Skill with the DLC Ultimate variant; no unsupported damage values inferred.
